board.name: Kria KV260 Vision AI Starter Kit

connection.route: AR1335 sensor module to on-board AP1302 sensor input 0, then AP1302 ISP output to the programmable-logic video pipeline

components.function: on-board image signal processor on the J7 IAS0 route

operator_confirmations: Confirm the camera flex cable is fully seated at J7/IAS0 with the correct contact orientation.
Confirm the intended AR1335 mode, pixel format, resolution, and frame rate before a hardware-qualified run.

discovery_checks: Media-controller graph contains AR1335, AP1302, MIPI CSI-2 receiver, and framebuffer/DMA entities.
A V4L2 capture node is present after the selected platform overlay is loaded.
MIPI lane, frame, CRC, and ECC status counters are readable.
functional_checks: Capture a deterministic sensor or ISP test pattern and verify dimensions, format, frame count, and content signature.
Capture bounded live frames and verify frame cadence, non-constant content, and zero mandatory MIPI protocol errors.
Capture an ILA/System ILA trace at the AXI4-Stream video boundary.

evidence.finding: ON Semiconductor AR1335 IAS camera module is physically connected to J7.

evidence.reference: AMD UG1089 Interfaces and Supported Peripherals
evidence.finding: J7 is IAS0, supports four MIPI lanes, connects to AP1302 sensor input 0, and AR1335 is a functionally tested J7 peripheral.
Installed overlay metadata contains onnn,ar1335, onnn,ap1302, and Xilinx MIPI CSI-2 receiver nodes.

peripheral_instances.model: Pmod I2S2 Stereo Audio Input and Output

connection.route: Two I2S interfaces between KV260 programmable logic and the Pmod I2S2 ADC/DAC

operator_confirmations: Confirm the Pmod I2S2 input clock-mode jumper position before selecting host or codec clock-master behavior.
Confirm any analog input source connected to line in before requiring capture validation.

discovery_checks: ALSA exposes the Xilinx I2S capture and playback PCM devices after the selected platform overlay is loaded.
I2S MCLK, LRCLK, SCLK, ADC data, and DAC data are mapped to the J2 Pmod pins and observable with ILA.
functional_checks: Play a deterministic stereo tone through DMA and verify I2S frame timing and sample words with ILA.
Capture a deterministic line-in or loopback signal and compare sample count, channel ordering, frequency, and amplitude bounds.
Run simultaneous capture/playback long enough to check DMA continuity and underrun/overrun counters.

evidence.finding: Digilent Pmod I2S2 is connected and its line-out jack is connected to a speaker.

evidence.reference: AMD UG1089 Supported Peripherals and Digilent Pmod I2S2 product documentation
evidence.finding: AMD lists Digilent SKU 410-379 on J2; Digilent specifies CS5343/CS4344 stereo I2S, 24-bit samples, and input rates up to 108 kHz.
Installed overlay metadata contains Xilinx I2S receiver, transmitter, audio formatter, DMA, and pmod-i2s-codec nodes.

peripheral_instances.model: Standard microphone connected to Pmod I2S2 line in

connection.route: External microphone analog signal to CS5343 ADC, then I2S capture into programmable logic

operator_confirmations: Confirm the microphone or its adapter provides a line-level signal or includes suitable bias and preamplification; the Pmod I2S2 line input does not provide a microphone preamp or microphone bias.
Confirm the microphone plug wiring and mono/stereo channel mapping are compatible with the Pmod I2S2 3.5 mm line-input jack.

discovery_checks: ALSA exposes the Pmod I2S2 capture PCM after the audio platform overlay is loaded.
ILA shows valid I2S receive clocks, framing, and changing ADC sample words.
functional_checks: Capture a bounded silence baseline and record RMS level, DC offset, and channel behavior.
Capture speech or a known acoustic tone and verify duration, non-clipping amplitude, frequency content, and expected active channel.
Use the microphone to capture a bounded speaker chirp and verify correlation for an end-to-end acoustic loopback test.

evidence.finding: A standard microphone is available for connection to the Pmod I2S2 line-input jack.
The line-input jack is AC-coupled to the CS5343 stereo ADC without an on-module microphone preamplifier or microphone-bias supply.

peripheral_instances.model: Speaker connected to Pmod I2S2 line out

connection.route: CS4344 DAC analog line output to external speaker

operator_confirmations: Set a conservative initial playback amplitude before enabling the output.

discovery_checks: Operator confirms the speaker or amplifier connection and safe volume state.
functional_checks: Play a bounded low-amplitude tone and obtain manual or instrumented output evidence.
For automated qualification, route line out to a capture device or use a calibrated microphone and verify frequency correlation.

evidence.finding: A powered/amplified speaker is connected to the Pmod I2S2 line-out jack.
